title: PayPal Fee Calculator (US, Invoicing & Cross-Border FX)
meta_description: Calculate PayPal merchant fees, international cross-border surcharges, currency conversion spreads, and reverse invoice totals for exact payouts.
lead: Estimate exact PayPal seller fees across standard commercial rates, PayPal Invoicing, international surcharges, and FX spreads.

options.label: Forward — Invoice amount to net payout
Reverse — Target net payout to invoice amount

formula_html:
Total Rate: Base % + International Surcharge (1.5% if enabled) + FX Spread %.

Reverse Formula: Invoice = (Target Net + Fixed Fee) / (1 - Total Rate).

faqs.q: Why do international PayPal payments lose 7%–9%?
faqs.a: When combining the commercial fee (3.49%), the cross-border surcharge (1.50%), and PayPal's currency conversion spread (3%–4%), total deductions frequently exceed 8%.

faqs.q: Can I ask clients to cover PayPal fees using reverse calculation?
faqs.a: Switch to Reverse mode above to see the gross invoice total needed to receive your full target amount after fees. Always verify local surcharging rules.
